sources.entry: toprank - Open-source (MIT) Claude Code plugin with 9 SEO and Google Ads skills. Pulls real Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, and Google Ads API data, audits traffic and wasted ad spend, rewrites meta tags, generates JSON-LD schema markup, and ships the fixes directly to source or CMS (WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, Ghost).

summary.one_liner: NotFair Plugin is an MIT-licensed set of SEO, GEO, paid-media, analytics, WordPress and CRM skills for AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, which pull live account data through one OAuth-connected MCP server.
summary.what_it_does: The repository ships 48 skills, each with a SKILL.md entry point and a WORKFLOW.md containing the procedure, with optional references, scripts and evals. Skill categories cover SEO and GEO audits, keyword research, meta tags, schema markup, local and international SEO, and sitemap and backlink checks. Paid-media skills cover planning, review and optimization, plus Google Ads, Meta Ads, X Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, TikTok Ads, and Amazon and ChatGPT Ads as planning or export-review workflows. Analytics skills query live GA4 and Search Console data, and WordPress and GoHighLevel skills operate connected accounts. Live data comes from a single hosted NotFair MCP connection that the agent reaches after browser OAuth, and the README says changes should be explicitly authorized and verified. A separate Gemini skill provides cross-model review.
use_cases: audit a website's SEO and find why organic traffic dropped
review Google Ads or Meta Ads spend for wasted budget
optimize content for citation in AI answer engines
analyze GA4 and Search Console data for a site
plan and review multi-channel paid ad campaigns
manage WordPress content or GoHighLevel CRM contacts through an agent
how_to_run: codex plugin marketplace add nowork-studio/notfair-plugin --json && codex plugin add notfair@nowork-studio --json && codex mcp login NotFair
gemini extensions install <repository URL from README>
notable: 48 skills organized into SEO/GEO, paid media, platform-specific ads, analytics, WordPress and CRM categories
One universal OAuth-connected NotFair MCP server shared across all supported platforms
Skills are plain, host-agnostic Markdown workflows that can be read, adapted and forked
Read-only review is required before any account mutation, with explicit approval boundaries for paid-media changes
AGENTS.md acts as an intent-to-skill resolver for agents
caveats: Live account analysis requires connecting accounts through the NotFair MCP and OAuth; Amazon and ChatGPT Ads remain planning or export-review only unless a verified connector is exposed
Some local scripts need separate credentials, such as a Google Cloud login, CMS application passwords, or a Gemini API key
Install commands differ by host, and Cursor's local-install path is described as a testing step before marketplace listing
